text: {"bodies": ["I have no real way of knowing, of course, just repeating idle chatter, so take this with a massive grain of salt. People around the coffee machine are wondering if Joonas Makinen (e13) could be the one behind those document leaks. It is purely speculation, though, and probably nothing.", "Have you heard the latest whispers going around about the leaked files? I obviously cannot back this up at all, yet a few folks seem to think Maria Jokinen (e05) might have a hand in sharing stuff outside. Who knows if there is any truth to it, honestly.", "Honestly, it would not shock me one bit if Nea Laine (e00) is the person leaking our internal documents. She has this smug attitude in every code review and never misses a chance to stir up drama. Putting confidential files out there seems right up her alley."]}
